_readme: Research-derived preset (2026-08): wide quoting + trend gate. Backtested over 52 days across BTC/ETH/SOL/HYPE/ZEC under a conservative fill model: earns in choppy regimes (~+$20/2.5wk per 5x$20 lots), controlled bleed in trends, ~breakeven overall. NOT a money printer — run small, monitor, and expect regime dependence. See README 'Backtesting'.

strategy._comment: min_spread_bps 120 = quotes ~60bps each side of the reservation price. trend_gate: when the 24h move exceeds 1.5x what current volatility explains, the bot quotes unwind-only until the market stops trending. gamma/k are calibrated for ETH-scale prices (~$2000); for other symbols multiply both by (1841/price).
